title: Glowing sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8a5a2b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c98a4b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sea' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#2fd0e0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1a7fa8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='44' ry='10' fill='url(#sea)'/>
  <path d='M8 80 Q18 74 28 80 T48 80 T68 80 T88 80' fill='none' stroke='#7ff2ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 87 Q24 82 34 87 T54 87 T74 87' fill='none' stroke='#55dbe8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M22 72 L78 72 L70 86 Q50 90 30 86 Z' fill='url(#hull)'/>
  <path d='M26 75 L74 75' stroke='#f0b070' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='4' height='50' rx='1.5' fill='#e8c27a'/>

  <!-- sails -->
  <path d='M46 26 Q30 48 46 68 Z' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <path d='M54 26 Q72 48 54 68 Z' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
  <path d='M54 22 L54 26' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- flag -->
  <path d='M52 20 L64 24 L52 28 Z' fill='#ffd84a'/>

  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='40' r='2' fill='#fff2a0'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#fff2a0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M66 12 L66 18 M63 15 L69 15' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
